command: set -u; echo '===IDENTITY==='; hostname; whoami; date -Is; echo '===OMEGA_RUNTIME_FILES==='; find "$HOME" -maxdepth 5 -type f -path '*/scripts/omega_runtime.py' -print 2>/dev/null | head -20; echo '===FRANK_REPOS==='; for d in "$HOME/frankenstein" "$HOME/frankenstein-repo" "$HOME/Project-Frankenstein" "$HOME/.claude/star"; do if [ -d "$d/.git" ]; then echo "--- $d"; git -C "$d" rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null || true; git -C "$d" branch --show-current 2>/dev/null || true; git -C "$d" status --porcelain=v1 2>/dev/null | head -30 || true; fi; done; echo '===SERVICES==='; systemctl --user --no-pager --plain --type=service --all 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei 'omega|frankenstein|entityos|grid|stern' || true; echo '===PROCESSES==='; ps -eo pid=,lstart=,args= | grep -Ei 'omega_runtime|stern.py|frankenstein|grid10|voice_realtime|entityos' | grep -v grep | head -80 || true
